# SMART Qualifications

> > YMCA Awards approved fitness education provider offering Level 1-4 qualifications in gym instructing, personal training, group exercise, nutrition, and specialist courses including perinatal and menopause support.

Based in Peterborough, UK, SMART Qualifications has delivered fitness industry education for 25+ years with blended learning options including face-to-face and ZOOM delivery. CIMSPA recognized courses available with 0% PayPal payment plans.

## Key Topics

- YMCA Awards certification
- Level 2 Gym Instructing
- Level 3 Personal Training
- Blended learning delivery
- Group exercise instruction
- Perinatal fitness specialist
- Nutrition for physical activity
- CIMSPA recognition
- Children and young people physical activity
- Chair-based exercise
- Suspended movement training
- Studio resistance training
- Menopause support in fitness
- Internal quality assurance (IQA)
- Distance learning fitness courses

## Core Qualifications

- [L2 Gym & L3 PT Diploma](https://smartqualifications.com/l2-gym-l3-pt-diploma): Combined Level 3 Diploma for gym instructors and personal trainers
- [Level 1 Award in Fitness and Physical Activity](https://smartqualifications.com/courses/level-1-award-in-fitness-and-physical-activity): YMCA Level 1 fitness introduction course, no prerequisites required
- [L1 Award in Fitness and Physical Activity](https://smartqualifications.com/l1-award-in-fitness-and-physical-activity): Entry-level YMCA Level 1 fitness qualification with blended learning
- [L2 Award in Children Physical Activity](https://smartqualifications.com/l2-award-in-children-physical-activity-course): YMCA Level 2 for engaging children/young people in sport and activity
- [Level 2 Award in Studio Resistance Training](https://smartqualifications.com/courses/level-2-award-in-studio-resistance-training): YMCA Level 2 for teaching studio resistance with barbells and bands

## Group Exercise Instructor Courses

- [L2 STEP Award](https://smartqualifications.com/l2-step-certificate): Level 2 Award in STEP Exercise to Music for group exercise instructors
- [L2 STEP Certificate](https://smartqualifications.com/l2-step-certificate-2): Level 2 Certificate in STEP Exercise to Music group instructor course

## Specialist Level 3 Qualifications

- [L3 Nutrition](https://smartqualifications.com/l3-nutrition): YMCA Level 3 Award in Nutrition for Physical Activity and Exercise
- [Level 3 Award in Nutrition for Physical Activity and Exercise](https://smartqualifications.com/courses/level-3-award-in-nutrition-for-exercise-and-health-course): YMCA Level 3 nutrition qualification for fitness professionals
- [L3 Ante & Post Natal](https://smartqualifications.com/l3-ante-post-natal): YMCA Level 3 perinatal fitness qualification for pre/post natal training
- [YMCA Level 3 Perinatal Practitioner](https://smartqualifications.com/courses/ymca-level-3-award-in-supporting-participation-in-physical-activity-perinatal-copy): YMCA Level 3 perinatal practitioner for ante/post natal exercise delivery
- [L3 Supporting Menopause](https://smartqualifications.com/courses/l3-supporting-menopause): YMCA Level 3 Award for supporting menopause in physical activity

## Workshops & Continuing Education

- [Boxing Fitness Workshop](https://smartqualifications.com/courses/boxing-fitness-workshop): Boxing fitness skills workshop with certificate of attendance
- [Advanced Kettlebell Workshop](https://smartqualifications.com/advanced-kettlebell-workshop): Advanced kettlebell techniques: jerk, snatch, long cycle, double bell
- [Pilates Balls and Bands Workshop](https://smartqualifications.com/courses/pilates-bands-workshop): Pilates workshop covering balls, bands, and resistance equipment safety
